sentences.text: There are two kinds of scene.
A standard scene has charts, photos, keyframed motion and ready-made blocks.
sentences.phonemes: ɐ stˈændɚd sˈiːn hɐz tʃˈɑːɹts, fˈoʊɾoʊz, kˈiːfɹeɪmd mˈoʊʃən ænd ɹˈɛdimˌeɪd blˈɑːks.

sentences.text: A drawn scene has text, shapes and icons, drawn in order, with no keyframes.
sentences.phonemes: ɐ dɹˈɔːn sˈiːn hɐz tˈɛkst, ʃˈeɪps ænd ˈaɪkɑːnz, dɹˈɔːn ɪn ˈɔːɹdɚ, wɪð nˈoʊ kˈiːfɹeɪmz.
